title: fix(setUiState): display experimental warning
body:
## Description

Before releasing the new set of APIs to control the UI state, we mark them as experimental to gather feedback and change their APIs in a next minor if needed.

The warning only happens in `setUiState` because `onStateChange` relies on `setUiState`.

## Related

- API documentation: algolia/doc#4352

comments.body: @Haroenv We could, but since `onStateChange` is always used with `setUiState`, the warning will likely be unnecessary.
Yes, but the warning would be called only once, versus now on every call of setUiState. No big difference of course, since we cache warnings
@Haroenv Yep but if we only use the warning in `onStateChange`, users using the `setUiState` API (for injecting a UI state only once) won't see the warning.
Merging since doc PR was merged.
